text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Matikanefukukitaru came running over to 
me, puffing and panting excitedly!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Reverse Fortune-Telling Tiiime"! Trainer, 
that moment has finally arrived!
choice_data_list: What do you mean, reverse fortune-telling?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Usually, I'm the one who reads the 
fortunes. But this time, as a bloody 
massive special bonus!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"It turns out, Trainer-san, you're the one 
who can read my fortune."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Come on, please! How does it look for my 
afternoon race? What kind of result do you 
think I'll get?
choice_data_list:
Don't just spring that on me out of 
nowhere...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I can't see the future at all." Just as I 
was thinking that to myself...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Fukukitaru-san's future...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: In that case... I might have seen it...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, a voice came from beside me 
where there had been no sign of anyone!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Nyoe!? You're— Manhattan Cafe-san!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Elusive and wondrous. Appearing and 
vanishing in the blink of an eye—aren't 
you that otherworldly Umamusume!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Cafe-san, you just said 'I saw it', right? 
Did you see my future?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Well... I mean, that's...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Last night, I ended up having a dream 
about Fukukitaru-san—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Huh, I was in Cafe-san's dream!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
So, what happened? A dream from someone as 
mysterious as Cafe must have had some sort 
of deeper meaning, right?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: We'd love to hear all about that!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Understood.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Actually, in today's mock race... you...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a bad premonition, I took Manhattan 
Cafe aside and asked her about it...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Fukukitaru-san, in my dream, I finished 
dead last...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
During the race, I was swallowed up by a 
mysterious shadow approaching from 
behind...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After all... How should I convey this 
dream?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Trainerrr, Cafe-san. It's not fair, 
keeping all the chatting to yourselves~

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Let me in on this too! So, how was I? The 
me in your dream.
choice_data_list: Apparently, they finished in dead last.
Apparently, it was a massive victory.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Wh-What on earth!? Is that true, 
Cafe-san!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
You're saying dream-me was dead last, 
bottom of the barrel, Don Sanchos rock 
bottom!?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I was caught by the black shadow 
stretching out from behind me...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Mugacho~!! If it's Cafe-san's dream, I 
don't think it's entirely nonsense either.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
If Don Sanchos's shadow catches you, it's 
game over... Mmh-mmh-mmh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And in the mock race that followed...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Outta the way, outta the way, outta the 
way—! I won't let myself get eaten like 
this!

text_block_list.name: Leading Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
W-What?! Wait, Matikanefukukitaru?! Why in 
the world are you in such a panic...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
If you don't run away quickly, Don Sanchos 
will eat you up too, you know? That 
Mexican evil spirit!

text_block_list.name: Leading Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Ehh, what's that supposed to mean~?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She's putting pressure on the Umamusume in 
the lead. It seems her fear has turned 
into a source of strength.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Grand victory!? Not just a regular 
victory, but big? Mmh, mmh-mmh~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I sense immense good fortune heading our 
way! Especially with Cafe-san's official 
seal of approval!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's settled, let's go all out 
and run wild. We have nothing left to 
fear.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
And the race starts! To-yaaaah, total 
victoryyy!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What I told her was a lie. Even so, 
Matikanefukukitaru believed it blindly and 
ran away with a crushing victory.
